messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
allah ya kare yan uwa musulmai allah ya kare kasar mu nigeria allah duk wanda keda hannu kan lamarin boko haram allah ya kawar mn dashi allah dan soyyy mu da annabi muhammad da alfarmar wnnn watan

output.original_text: allah ya kare yan uwa musulmai allah ya kare kasar mu nigeria allah duk wanda keda hannu kan lamarin boko haram allah ya kawar mn dashi allah dan soyyy mu da annabi muhammad da alfarmar wnnn watan
output.joy: Allah ya kawo mana lafiya da zaman lafiya! Allah ya kare yan uwa musulmai da kasar mu, Najeriya. Duk wanda ke da hannu akan Boko Haram, Allah ya kawar da su. Muna rokon Allah da kaunar mu kamar yadda ya so da Annabi Muhammad a wannan watan.
output.sadness: Ya Allah, mu yi addu'a domin yan uwa musulmai da kasar mu, Najeriya. Wannan akwai wahala tare da Boko Haram, Allah ya kare mu duka. Mun juri wahala daga duk wanda ke hannu a lamarin.
output.fear: Ya Allah, muna fargaba game da Boko Haram. Allah ya kare yan uwa musulmai da kasar mu, Najeriya. Duk wanda ke da hannu a wannan mummunan al'amari, Allah ya kawar da su, don muna jin tsoro.
output.anger: Ya Allah, ina jin haushi game da Boko Haram! Allah ya kare yan uwa musulmai da kasar mu, Najeriya. Duk wanda ke da hannu a wannan tashin hankali, Allah ya kawar da su, saboda ba za mu iya jure wannan ba!
output.surprise: Ya Allah, wannan rashin tabbaci da Boko Haram ya yi a Najeriya ya yi matukar mamaki! Muna rokon Allah ya kare yan uwa musulmai da kasar mu. Duk da haka, Allah ya watsar da duk wanda ke da hannu a wannan al'amari.
output.disgust: Ya Allah, wannan hali da Boko Haram ke yi yana da zurfin rashin jin dadi! Allah ya kare yan uwa musulmai da kasar mu, Najeriya. Duk wanda ke da hannu a wannan sharrin, Allah ya kawar da su, saboda ba mu yarda da wannan ba!
